Usage#
Copy
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetClose,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetFooter,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet"
Copy
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger>Open</SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent>
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>Are you absolutely sure?</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription>This action cannot be undone.</SheetDescription>
    </SheetHeader>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
